translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: 1 Timote
book.title: 1 Timote Maktumne ta awalle taat Pool siiriiji ɗo Timote

content: Karaamin ta ɓerrinar ɗo geen̰co
Ɗo bi ka ɓerrin kuuk aamine, okin̰co, ŋuu karmiye geen̰co ho ŋuuco bere horoomin dakina. Paa kat, ŋu nigaaɗo biŋkico iŋ siŋ ku Buŋdi ho ŋu cillaagɗo ɓildin̰ji.

Ya geen̰co kuuk ŋu ginaaco riyo kat aamine, illa ŋuu karmiyin̰co. Ya ŋu pooca karmiyin̰co ɗo saan taat a ŋu siŋta, pa-ak, ta bal ase. Ŋuuco ginguwe riy dakin paka asaan gee kuuk gasa min ɗo riyco-ak, ŋuur gee kuuk aamin ɗo Iisa Masi ho ŋu siŋta kuuk ŋu elgiyo. Ɓilde ka jookumo iŋ ele ka mallel Naan̰ gaare maan kaak kii ɓilde gee ho maman kii taaƴin̰co.
Ya gem ɓilda gee iŋ ɓilde ka pey ho ya ŋa jaga min kaawin kuuk ka seener ku *Rabbinte Iisa Masi iŋ ɓilde ka arro ka imaante-ak,
ŋa ɗapila maalan di. Ŋa ibanno maanna. Ŋa el bariye meelo ho ŋa el giɗaw ɗo baaco ta kaawnar. Ŋaar-aŋ ko maan kaak iya hasuudinaw, meelo, nige ka biŋkar ho pikirre taat samaanno ɗo gemor.
Ampa-ak, gee meela lagat-lagat iŋ pikirrico taat ginno baati. Ŋu ginno tak-tak seen ta Buŋdi. Ɗo tan̰co, ŋu pakira a wal imaan ta ɗo Buŋdi-at, taar botol ta ŋuu gase malle.
Ka seener, gem kaak gin imaan ɗo Buŋdi gin ko malle dakina, ya ŋa hamdiy iŋ kaak Buŋ beriiji.
Asaan gi bal iye yoo maanna ɗo duniiner ho gi gediraaɗo oki ice yoo maanna minninti.
Ŋaar-ak, ya gi tiyaw ho siyaw, ho gi isaw-ak di, necinteŋ ko.
Kar ŋuur kuuk raka gine gay gamnar gay, niyinco taat kuunayɗo iŋ botol ta Buŋdi n̰aamiig ŋu galiy ɗo pise ka *Seetanner. Iŋ ele ka gamin ku duniiner-ak, ŋu idiy ziŋkico ho ŋu rawtiig goyin̰co.
Ele ka mallel-aŋ, ŋaar ko baaco ta gamin okin̰co kuuk jookumo. Gee daarin̰ diya kaƴco ɗo bariye ka malle, ansii ko ŋu jagtu serek min ɗo imaan ho ŋu iytu taaɓin dakina ɗo kaƴco.
Obe ka tirit ɗo imaandi

Kar gay, kiŋ kat gem ka Buŋdi, goy serek min gamin-aŋku. Baray maman kii gine ay maanna iŋ botiliy, kii gaare iŋ goyin̰ji kadar ki karmiya Buŋ, kii obin imaanjiŋ bombo, kii ele gee, kii ice subirraw ho kii goye dalulle.
Taasan̰ taasin̰ka taat taɓ ɗo imaandi. Ob tirit ɗo goye ka gaasɗo. Goye ŋaar-ak ko Buŋ kolin̰ciŋ ɗo wiktin taat ki piltu bin̰ ɗo uŋco ka saadinna dakina a ki aamin ɗo Iisa Masi.
Iŋ siŋ ku Buŋ kaak bera siikime ɗo ay maanna ho iŋ siŋ ku Iisa Masi kaak gaar imaanji ɗo uŋji ka guberneer Pilaat
, nu kaawaajiŋ aman :
gin ay maan kaak Buŋ kaawiijiŋ iŋ gelbin kaak *cawar ho bal oorne nam ƴiriy taat *Rabbinte Iisa Masi yaa bayne.
Baynin̰ji-ak yaa kuuniye ɗo wiktin taat meen̰ji Buŋ diytu.

content.text: Ŋaar keeji di Sultan kaak taɓ,
Ŋa goy ɗo portikaw taat waan sa ɓaatiɗo moota.
ho ginno waan kaak yaa gedire talin̰ji.
Horoomine ho iŋ gudurre loci doo ! *Aamin.

content: Taaƴiik ta Pool ɗo gay gamnar

Ɗo ŋuur kuuk gay gamnar kuuk goy ɗo adiy ka kiɗar-aŋ, kaawco a ŋu jaalenno ziŋkico. Kaawco a ŋu diyenno kaƴco ɗo malle kaak yaa uce us maala. Kar gay, ŋuu diye gelbinco iŋ Buŋ. Ŋaar kat beraate ay maanna, ŋa beraate dakina, ampa kat gii aaciye.
Kaawco a ŋuu gine selliŋkaw, ŋuu kuuniye gay gamnar ɗo gamin kuuk samaane ŋu giniyo, ŋuu gine oyaw ho ŋuu ɗeeɗguwe gaminco iŋ gee ku pey.
Ya ŋu gina pa-ak, ŋuu n̰ume malle kaak samaane ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi ho kaak neginda ucaaɗo usu. Ansii kat, ŋuu gase goye kaak taɓ.
Ooy ta ba aaro

Gem kol roŋji Timote, obig gamin kuuk Buŋ beriijiŋ-aŋ samaane ɗo adin̰. Gooƴ zin̰ min meel taat bal baati ho taat arro iŋ imaan. Gooƴ oki zin̰ min meel taat gee talaat ar ŋa ibine kaak taɓ, kar sando ta raadine.
Gee daarin̰ icig ibine ŋaar-aka. Ampaa ko, ŋu jagtu serek min imaan. Buŋ yaako barkiyiŋko okiŋko. Nu ooyko dakina.
